notes: Day zero. Every signal weight is 0.0 (the 'Dominance started at 0' rule): nothing has earned weight until the walk-forward optimizer proves it beats the incumbent by the NEVER-REGRESS margin on leak-safe held-out log-loss. Names mirror scripts/signals/registry.py byte-for-byte.

projection_baseline.games_source: player_history seasons.games (ESPN kona statId 210, the same actuals entry as prior_season_points)
projection_baseline.absence_source: data/injuries.json (ESPN injury report, scripts/availability.py canonical codes; blocked weeks per scripts/build_weekly.blocked_week_count: stated duration, out-for-season, or the 4-game IR/PUP/NFI floor)

shipped.reason: owner: ship the scenario estimate now; gate keeps scoring gated vs candidate
shipped.gated_series: gated_points/gated_low/gated_high (+ gated_rule) on every record; the ledger scores shipped, candidate and gated

gate.reason: NEVER REGRESS for the shipped number: pooled rank-corr 0.5847 -> 0.6032, pooled MAE 59.4697 -> 60.7557 — the per-game rule must improve BOTH to replace prior_season_points; it ships as the CANDIDATE baseline instead

candidate.sd_rule: +/- 2.25 x band around candidate_points, band = position volatility (QB .14 / RB .22 / WR .20 / TE .24) + 0.06 for an unresolved or long-term injury tag + 0.04 for a >25% missed-games history + half the age-curve move, clamped to [0.05, 0.60]; the multiplier is calibrated so the 2024->2025 backtest band covers ~0.68 of actuals (one sd) — an estimate of spread, not a measurement

learning_record.note: ledger has no locked (pre-kickoff) player-week yet — the first week locks on the first append after its kickoff

backtest_2025.sleeper_note: Sleeper 2025 weekly projections (category 'proj', Rotowire) summed over weeks 1-18, 330 history players matched by {'espn_id': 110, 'name_position': 188, 'team_def': 32} — DISPLAY-ONLY reference, never an input. NOT LIKE-FOR-LIKE: each week's number was made that week, so injuries, benchings and role changes are already known to it; a preseason season-long projection cannot know them, and the gap flatters Sleeper by construction.
